summary: Teakwood Interiors will supply and fit twelve desks and twelve chairs at Saffron Ledger Accountants' office for Rs. 2,40,000 plus GST. Delivery is due within ten days of the order or payment. Saffron Ledger Accountants reimburses Teakwood Interiors' travel and accommodation costs over Rs. 5,000. For each week the goods are late, the price goes down by Rs. 2,000. Teakwood Interiors repairs or replaces any item that breaks within one year of fitting, at no charge. Indian law applies, and the courts at Indore have jurisdiction.
